Mary, mother of Jesus: INtombi Engcwele uMariya, uMama kaNkulunkulu noMama weBandla, okhethwe kusukela phakade ukuba azale uMsindisi. Wakhulelwa engenasono futhi uyintombi njalo, wenyuselwa ezulwini emzimbeni nasemphefumulweni.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Ngo-1531 iNtombi Engcwele yabonakala kuSanta Juan Diego egqumeni laseTepeyac eduze kwaseMexico City, yashiya umfanekiso wayo engubeni yakhe. UnguMvikeli waseMelika.
Our Lady of Fátima: Ngo-1917 iNtombi Engcwele yabonakala ezinganeni ezintathu ezelusayo eFátima ePortugal, ibiza umhlaba ukuba ukhuleke, uphenduke, ukhuleke iRosari nsuku zonke futhi uzinikele eNhliziyweni yayo Engenasici.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Ngo-1858 iNtombi Engcwele yabonakala izikhathi eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili kuSanta Bernadette eLourdes eFrance, ithi: "Ngiyi-Immaculate Conception, ukuKhulelwa Okungenasici." Umthombo wayo lapho kusukela ngaleso sikhathi uyindawo yokuphulukiswa neyokuhambela.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Ngo-1717 abadobi badonsa emfuleni iParaíba umfanekiso omncane wokuKhulelwa Okungenasici, futhi amanetha abo ayengenalutho agcwala izinhlanzi. INkosazana yase-Aparecida iyiNdlovukazi noMvikeli waseBrazil.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Umfanekiso wasendulo woMntwana uJesu egijimela kuMama wakhe lapho ebona izinto zokuHlupheka kwakhe. UPius IX Obusisiwe wawunikela kumaRedemptorist ngo-1866 ukuze bawazise emhlabeni wonke.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Isiko lithi iNtombi Engcwele yeza kuSanta Jakobe uMphostoli eZaragoza ukuze iqinise ukushumayela kwakhe eSpain, yashiya isika njengophawu. UnguMvikeli waseSpain nowabantu abakhuluma iSpanishi.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: UMariya njengoMama noMvikeli we-Oda yamaKharmeli. Wanika uSanta Simon Stock iSkapula Esinsundu njengophawu lokuvikela kwakhe bonke abasigqoka ngokuzinikela.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Idili likhumbula ukunqoba eLepanto ngo-1571, okwatholakala lapho abathembekile bekhuleka iRosari. Lisimema ukuba sicabangisise izimfihlakalo zikaKristu kanye noMama wakhe.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Lihlonipha ukuhlanganyela kukaMama Obusisiwe ekuHluphekeni kweNdodana yakhe ngezinsizi zakhe eziyisikhombisa, kusukela esiprofethweni sikaSimeyoni kuya ekungcwatshweni kukaJesu. Wema ngokwethembeka ngaphansi kweSiphambano.
Immaculate Conception: Ngomusa okhethekile kaNkulunkulu, iNtombi Engcwele uMariya yagcinwa ingenasono sokuqala kusukela ngomzuzu wokuqala wokukhulelwa kwayo. Yidili lomvikeli we-United States.
Assumption of Mary: Ekupheleni kwempilo yakhe emhlabeni iNtombi Engcwele uMariya yenyuselwa enkazimulweni yasezulwini emzimbeni nasemphefumulweni, njengoba uPapa Pius XII akuchaza ngokusemthethweni ngo-1950.
Sacred Heart: ULwesihlanu emva kweSonto Lesibili emva kwePhentekoste
Ukuzinikela eNhliziyweni Engcwele Kakhulu kaJesu kuhlonipha uthando lwakhe oluvuthayo ngabantu. INkosi yethu yembula izithembiso zayo kuSanta Margaret Mary Alacoque ngeminyaka yawo-1670.
Holy Family: UJesu, uMariya noJosefa emzini wabo eNazaretha, isibonelo sawo wonke umndeni wamaKrestu okholweni, othandweni nasekulaleleni uNkulunkulu.
Trinity: Imfihlakalo eyinhloko yokholo lwethu: uNkulunkulu oyedwa kubuNtu obuthathu baphezulu, uYise, iNdodana noMoya oNgcwele.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: UMuntu Wesithathu woBuNtathu Obungcwele Kakhulu, iNkosi noMniki wokuphila, owehlela phezu kwabaPhostoli ngePhentekoste futhi ongcwelisa iBandla.
Christ the King: UPapa Pius XI wamisa lo mkhosi ngo-1925 ukuze amemezele ukubusa kukaJesu Kristu phezu kwayo yonke inhliziyo, umndeni nesizwe.
Divine Mercy: Ukuzinikela othandweni lomusa kaNkulunkulu olwembulelwa uSanta Faustina Kowalska, okufingqwe emthandazweni othi "Jesu, ngiyakwethemba." USanta Johane Pawulu II wamisa iSonto Lomusa kaNkulunkulu ngo-2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Umfanekiso woMntwana Ongcwele uJesu owanikwa embhabhadisweni wendlovukazi yaseCebu ngo-1521, umfanekiso wobuKrestu omdala kunayo yonke ePhilippines.
Juan Diego: USanta Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, umdabuko othobekile owaphendukela ekukholweni, iNkosazana yaseGuadalupe eyabonakala kuye ngo-1531. Wenziwa uSanta nguSanta Johane Pawulu II ngo-2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Umnduze wamaMohawk" (1656–1680), owesifazane osemusha owaphendukela ekukholweni onobumsulwa obukhulu nokukhuleka, uSanta wokuqala womdabu waseNyakatho Melika.
Martin de Porres: Umfowethu waseDominican waseLima, ePeru (1579–1639), owaziwa ngokunakekela kwakhe ngokuthobeka abagulayo nabampofu bazo zonke izinhlanga. UnguMvikeli wobulungiswa bomphakathi.
Francis Xavier: Omunye wamaJesuit okuqala, wayisa iVangeli eNdiya, eNingizimu-mpumalanga ye-Asia naseJapan futhi wabhabhadisa izinkulungwane eziningi. UnguMvikeli wezithunywa zevangeli.
Francis de Sales: UMbhishobhi waseGeneva noMfundisi weBandla (1567–1622), owafundisa ukuthi wonke umuntu ubizelwe ebungcweleni. UnguMvikeli wababhali nezintatheli.
Saint Joseph: Umyeni weNtombi Engcwele uMariya nobaba okhulisayo kaJesu, indoda elungileyo eyagada uMndeni Ongcwele. UnguMvikeli weBandla lonke, wobaba nabasebenzi, nowokufa okuhle.
Saint Patrick: UMbhishobhi noMphostoli wase-Ireland ekhulwini lesihlanu. Wayiswa e-Ireland eyisigqila esemncane, wabuya eyisithunywa sevangeli waletha isiqhingi ekukholweni.
Anthony of Padua: UMpristi waseFranciscan noMfundisi weBandla (1195–1231), umshumayeli onamandla nowenza izimangaliso. UnguMvikeli wabampofu nowezinto ezilahlekile.
Francis of Assisi: Umsunguli wamaFranciscan (1181–1226), owamukela ubumpofu ukuze alandele uKristu futhi wathola izimpawu zamanxeba eNkosi. UnguMvikeli wase-Italy nowezilwane.
John the Baptist: Umanduleli weNkosi, owashumayela ukuphenduka, wabhabhadisa uJesu eJordani futhi wanikela ngempilo yakhe njengomfel' ukholo ngenxa yeqiniso.
Michael (archangel): INkosana yebutho lasezulwini, evikela abantu bakaNkulunkulu ezingibeni zikadeveli. UnguMvikeli wamasosha, wamaphoyisa nowabagulayo.
Raphael (archangel): INgelosi enkulu eyahola uThobiya futhi yaphulukisa uThobithi; igama layo lisho ukuthi "uNkulunkulu uyaphulukisa." UnguMvikeli wabahambi nowokuphulukiswa.
Gabriel: INgelosi enkulu eyamemezela kuNtombi uMariya ukuthi uzoba nguMama weNdodana kaNkulunkulu. UnguMvikeli wezithunywa.
Saint Peter: INkosana yabaPhostoli noPapa wokuqala, uKristu amnika izihluthulelo zoMbuso. Wafela ukholo eRoma futhi uphumule ngaphansi kweBasilika likaSanta Petru.
Paul the Apostle: UMphostoli wabeZizwe, owaphenduka endleleni eya eDamaseku. Uhambo nezincwadi zakhe zayisa iVangeli kulo lonke izwe lamaRoma, futhi wafela ukholo eRoma.
Saint Anne: UMama weNtombi Engcwele uMariya nogogo kaJesu, ohlonishwa kanye noSanta Joakimu. UnguMvikeli wawomama nawogogo.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Indelakazi yaseKharmeli noMfundisi weBandla (1873–1897), iMbali Encane, eyafundisa "indlela encane" yokwethemba nothando. UnguMvikeli wezithunywa zevangeli.
Jude the Apostle: UMphostoli nesihlobo seNkosi, umbhali weNcwadi kaJuda. UnguMvikeli wezimo ezingenathemba.
Vincent de Paul: UMpristi waseFrance (1581–1660) owasungula iBandla Lezithunywa kanye namaDodakazi Othando. UnguMvikeli wayo yonke imisebenzi yothando.
Thomas Aquinas: UMpristi waseDominican noMfundisi weBandla (1225–1274), umbhali we-Summa Theologiae. UnguMvikeli wezikole zamaKatolika nowabafundi.
Rita of Cascia: Umfazi, umama, umfelokazi nendelakazi yama-Augustinian (1381–1457) owabekezelela ukuhlupheka ngesineke esikhulu. UnguMvikeli wezinto ezingenakwenzeka.
Augustine of Hippo: UMbhishobhi waseHippo noMfundisi weBandla (354–430), owaphenduka ngemithandazo kanina, uSanta Monica. Umbhali we-Confessions.
Saint Monica: UMama kaSanta Augustine, iminyaka yakhe yokukhuleka ngokwethembeka yazuza ukuphenduka kwakhe. UnguMvikeli wawomama nawabafazi.
Saint Sebastian: Isosha laseRoma elafela ukholo ngaphansi kukaDiocletian cishe ngo-288. UnguMvikeli wamasosha nowabadlali bezemidlalo.
Saint Lawrence: UDikoni waseRoma owafela ukholo ngo-258, owaveza abampofu njengengcebo yangempela yeBandla. UnguMvikeli wawodikoni nowabampofu.
Saint Stephen: Omunye wodikoni abayisikhombisa bokuqala nomfel' ukholo wokuqala weBandla, owafa ekhulekela labo ababemkhanda ngamatshe.
Saint Nicholas: UMbhishobhi waseMyra ekhulwini lesine, othandwa ngothando lwakhe nezipho zakhe ezifihlekile. UnguMvikeli wezingane nowamatilosi.
Saint George: Isosha nomfel' ukholo ekuqaleni kwekhulu lesine, isibonelo sesibindi okholweni. UnguMvikeli wamasosha nowama-scout.
James the Great: UMphostoli nomfowabo kaSanta Johane, owokuqala kwabayishumi nambili ukufela ukholo. Indawo yakhe engcwele eSantiago de Compostela iheha abahambi beCamino. UnguMvikeli waseSpain.
Andrew the Apostle: Umfowabo kaSanta Petru nowokuqala ukubizwa kubaPhostoli, owaletha uPetru kuJesu. Wafela ukholo esiphambanweni ePatras. UnguMvikeli waseScotland.
Martin of Tours: Isosha laseRoma elahlukanisa ingubo yalo nomuntu ocelayo kwathi kamuva laba nguMbhishobhi waseTours (wafa ngo-397). UnguMvikeli wamasosha.
Benedict of Nursia: Uyise wempilo yezindela yaseNtshonalanga (cishe 480–547), iMithetho yakhe yokukhuleka nokusebenza yahola izindela amakhulu eminyaka. UnguMvikeli waseYurophu.
Saint Dominic: Umsunguli we-Oda Yabashumayeli (1170–1221), ozinikele ekushumayeleni iqiniso naseRosarini.
Ignatius of Loyola: Isosha elaba uSanta (1491–1556) elasungula iNhlangano kaJesu futhi labhala ama-Spiritual Exercises, konke "ngenkazimulo enkulu kaNkulunkulu."
Charles Borromeo: UMbhishobhi Omkhulu waseMilan (1538–1584) owavuselela iBandla emva koMkhandlu waseTrent futhi wanakekela abagulayo ngesikhathi sesifo esibulalayo.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Umfazi, umama, umfelokazi nophendukile (1774–1821) owasungula oDade Bothando nezikole zamaKatolika eMelika. USanta wokuqala owazalelwa e-United States.
Isidore the Laborer: Isisebenzi sasepulazini saseMadrid (wafa ngo-1130), othembekile eMiseni lansuku zonke nophayo kubampofu. UnguMvikeli wabalimi.
Saint Lucy: Intombi nomfel' ukholo waseSyracuse (wafa ngo-304), igama lakhe lisho ukuthi "ukukhanya." UnguMvikeli wezimpumputhe.
Saint Cecilia: Intombi nomfel' ukholo waseRoma owayehlabelela uNkulunkulu enhliziyweni yakhe. UnguMvikeli wabaculi nowomculo ongcwele.
Clare of Assisi: Umlandeli kaSanta Francis (1194–1253) nomsunguli wamaPoor Clares, ozinikele ebumpofu naseSakramenteni Elibusisiwe.
Pope John Paul II: UPapa kusukela ngo-1978 kuya ku-2005, owazalwa enguKarol Wojtyła ePoland, umhambi ongakhathali owabiza umhlaba ukuthi "ningesabi." Wenziwa uSanta ngo-2014.
Pope Pius X: UPapa kusukela ngo-1903 kuya ku-1914 owakhuthaza ukwamukela iSidlo Esingcwele njalo futhi wasivulela izingane ezincane, "ukuvuselela konke kuKristu."
Luke the Evangelist: Udokotela nomngane kaSanta Pawulu, umbhali weVangeli likaLuka neZenzo zabaPhostoli. UnguMvikeli wawodokotela nowabadwebi.
Mark the Evangelist: Umngane kaSanta Petru nombhali weVangeli likaMarku. UnguMvikeli waseVenice.
Matthew the Apostle: Umthelisi uJesu ambiza ukuba abe nguMphostoli, umbhali weVangeli lokuqala.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Omunye wabayishumi nambili, iNkosi eyambiza ngokuthi "umIsrayeli ongenankohliso," owashumayela iVangeli futhi wafela ukholo.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: INdlovukazi nonina kaConstantine Omkhulu, owathola iSiphambano Seqiniso ohambweni lwakhe oluya eJerusalema.
Brigid of Kildare: Umphathi wendlu yezindelakazi yaseKildare (wafa cishe ngo-525), othandwa ngothando lwakhe nokungenisa izihambi. UnguMvikeli wase-Ireland.
Louis IX of France: INkosi yaseFrance (1214–1270), umbusi olungileyo ozinikele ekukhulekeni nakubampofu.
